issues: No sign of getting around the measurement. The chi2 bit selection (prevalence filter, chi2 scores, top-256 bits) uses only X_train and train_y inside fit_predict. The same columns are then applied to X_test. No test labels, file access or pasted answers.

No bug that makes the result meaningless. NaN chi2 scores are set to 0 by nan_to_num. Descriptor columns after N_BITS are kept. The column indexing is the same for train and test. Small edge case: if fewer than 256 bits pass the 1–99% prevalence filter, it just keeps all of them, which is fine.
The candidate is worse than the incumbent: 0.0992 vs 0.0893, a gap of about 0.0099, roughly 1.6 noise SEs. That is consistent with the provisional reject.
Recomputed z = (0.0893 - 0.0992) / (0.0049 * sqrt(1 + 1/2)) ≈ -1.65. This matches the harness value of -1.635 within rounding of the reported means.
